channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Converse Taps Naruto Shippuden for the Fieriest of Chucks
item.description: The Converse x Naruto Shippuden collection features six iterations of the iconic Chuck Taylor in both High and Low versions.

item.title: Nike’s Huge Shoe Goes Big on Texture Too
item.description: Models like the Nike Vomero Premium Flat Stout are evidence that even the highest-tech runners are worth dressing up nowadays.

item.title: This Tastefully Techy Nike Runner Has Been Reduced to Perfection
item.description: The design gurus at the Swoosh have reduced the silhouette to make the Nike Ava X Volt Ice a lightweight running machine.

item.title: Stone Island Created New Balance’s Softest Sneaker Ever
item.description: Stone Island Ghost went to unprecedented lengths in making New Balance’s classic 574 sneaker a cohesive monomaterial shoe.

item.title: Turns Out, Nike’s Crazy-Advanced Air Max Has a Freakishly Drippy Cousin
item.description: Nike reveals the all-new Air Liquid Max, a DN-like sneaker featuring "liquid" soles. Here's everything on the model, including a pending Fragment collab.

item.title: Converse's Laceless Leather Chuck Taylor Is the Quirkiest of Them All
item.description: Converse's All-Star Aged TG OX sneaker is essentially a revival of a classic toggle Chuck Taylor wrapped in luxe leather.

item.title: Nike's Rugged ACG Duck Boot Is Kinda Weird, Kinda Wild, All Weather-Ready
item.description: Nike's ACG Woodside 2 High is a rugged yet clean duck boot offered in stylish colorways like "Platinum Violet."

item.title: Vans' Flattest Non-Skate Sneaker Is Even Better as a Slick Slipper
item.description: Remember Vans' Super Lowpro sneaker? It's a smooth suede mule now. Here's everything on the newest version of the flat model.

item.title: adidas' Scrumptious Samba-Flavored Sneaker Is a Butter-Soft Treat
item.description: adidas' Handball Spezial sneaker lands in buttery "Preloved Bronze" leather for its latest drop.

item.title: New Balance's Pistachio Dad Shoe Actually Goes Nuts
item.description: New Balance's banana matcha 992 sneaker is a sweet reminder of why New Balance is the father of all dad shoes.
